subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Which trusted-media promotion shape should own pathless `read` image results for this issue: original tool-args fallback, managed inbound-media persistence, or a narrower hybrid?
rationale: Both open fixes can restore delivery, but they make different trust-boundary choices for local paths versus persisted image bytes, so automation should not select the permanent shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt managed inbound media
options.body: Use the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442-style approach that persists trusted inline image bytes into managed inbound media, then require focused security review and real Feishu/shared-channel proof.

options.title: Repair start-args fallback
options.body: Port the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 approach to current files and explicitly prove that only trusted `read` paths can become outbound media.

options.title: Split Feishu-specific leftovers
options.body: Land a shared pathless read-image promotion fix, then keep direct Feishu `message`/streaming-card failures in their narrower follow-up issues.

recommendation.title: Adopt managed inbound media
recommendation.body: Use the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442-style approach that persists trusted inline image bytes into managed inbound media, then require focused security review and real Feishu/shared-channel proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the shared tool-media reply delivery boundary that would own the selected fix shape.
